subtitle.zh-CN: 白色小熊 · 小黑布鞋
subtitle.zh-TW: 白色小熊 · 小黑布鞋

description.zh-CN: 软乎乎的白色小熊，脸蛋粉粉的，系着棕色小领结，穿一双小黑布鞋，爱笑也爱撒娇。
description.zh-TW: 軟乎乎的白色小熊，臉蛋粉粉的，繫著棕色小領結，穿一雙小黑布鞋，愛笑也愛撒嬌。
description.en: A squishy white bear with pink cheeks, a brown bow tie and little black shoes. Loves to smile and be cuddled.

look: small white bear, round head, two dark-brown round ears, pink blush, tiny ":3" mouth, brown bow tie, little black shoes
